daily_summary.html:
Domestic Politics

Former President Jokowi has intensified his political activities with the Indonesian Solidarity Party (PSI), with Jokowi stating PSI's 2029 target goes beyond merely entering parliament. The move has drawn reactions from PDI-P and Gerindra, while PSI denied rumors it aims to secure Vice President Gibran's position, instead explaining Jokowi's political tour in Lampung. Jokowi also received ceremonial titles from five kingdoms at Kedaton Keagungan featuring symbolic rituals.

  • A Puspoll Indonesia survey found 43.8 percent of the public satisfied with Vice President Gibran's performance.
  • PAN party leader Zulhas urged the public not to underestimate celebrity politicians, saying they have talent.
  • Uya Kuya was officially inaugurated as PAN Jakarta chairman for the 2024-2029 period.
  • The Probolinggo mayor participated in signing support for pro-MBG actions in the city.
  • Presidential Communications Office (Bakom) said regarding MBG governance improvements there will certainly be those who are unhappy.
  • A DPR legislator called for the Ministry of Defence to halt military training for prospective village cooperative managers.
  • A DPR member said labour unions and Kadin must join the task force structure for layoff mitigation.

Foreign Policy & Defence

The Ministry of Defence sent home 32 pregnant participants from the Kopdes Merah Putih military training programme, while facing scrutiny after five prospective cooperative managers died during the training. The Defence Ministry disclosed the chronology of the deaths and explained physical training materials included drills and military salutes, while also partnering with the Health Ministry to strengthen oversight.

  • Indonesia and Australia deepened border security cooperation through bilateral engagement.
  • Indonesia conveyed condolences following the earthquake in Venezuela.
  • Indonesia and the United States strengthened investment and manufacturing partnerships through enhanced cooperation.
  • The Home Affairs Minister opened the Fulan Fehan Festival 2026 featuring friendship dances between Indonesia and Timor-Leste.
  • MER-C operates a clinic for Rohingya refugees in Lhokseumawe, Aceh.

Other

Indonesia's Agriculture Minister announced a new farming system targeting 12.4 tons per hectare in rice production. The government also moved to ease economic activity, with a ministry easing private investment in roll-on/roll-off logistics and backing a gas bill to boost manufacturing growth. The Ministry of Transportation is accelerating electrification of the Cikarang-Cikampek commuter rail line to reduce travel time.

  • Police are investigating the suicide of Dr. Icha in NTT who reportedly suffered depression after alleged intimidation by two DPRD members, with the Health Ministry promising a thorough investigation.
  • State investment holding company Danantara merged state-owned hotels under the InJourney brand.
  • Jakarta's Gambir Station will add commuter rail service to expand transport connectivity.
  • The Financial Services Authority reported South Sulawesi banking assets reached Rp 215.79 trillion with performance remaining positive.
  • The financial restructuring of the Whoosh high-speed rail will be a benchmark for extension of the line to Surabaya.
